cells.label: FUT_DEFERRED_LEG_CURVE_CURVATURE

grounds.finding: Curvature is a second difference over THREE curve points. The certified layer carries exactly TWO dated contracts per market. The union of column names across all 69 certified market files is exactly: Date, close, held, open_interest, ret, ret2, slope_ann, volume. There is no third leg, no second deferred price, and only ONE price level column (close, the front); ret2 is a RETURN, not a price.
evidence: C:\Users\binis\paper_trader\alpha_agent\r59\native.py lines 14-18 (ret = front, ret2 = SECOND (deferred), slope_ann = slope between the two)
C:\Users\binis\paper_trader\alpha_agent\r59\native.py lines 178-206 (loader builds ret, ret2, slope only)
grounds.consequence: The spec's assertion that this cell 'needs no new collection' is false. It needs collection that does not exist. The cell's entire novelty rests on the word CURVATURE, which this data cannot express.

grounds.finding: What IS computable from two legs is (a) the slope, already materialised as slope_ann, and (b) the front-minus-deferred return differential. The spec's own mechanism paragraph describes neither curvature nor anything new: 'whether the held-to-deferred basis is steep or flat RELATIVE TO THAT MARKET'S OWN history ... this dispersion mean-reverts'. That is slope_ann normalised by its own history.

addendum_01.title: Ruling on whether the r68_02 reopen condition COVERAGE_CLEARS_THE_FROZEN_FLOOR is satisfied by fixing the sample start from a measured coverage series
addendum_01.question_put: Does fixing the sample start at 2012 (or 2013) satisfy the reopen condition, or does the condition bind on the full recorded sample so the parent stays DATA_HOLD?
addendum_01.why_not_the_ground_you_offered: I am NOT ruling that the condition binds on the full recorded sample. On the interpretive question I would rule the other way (see conditional_ruling below). I am refusing on a prior and more basic ground: the coverage series the ruling would rest on is not a recorded artifact anywhere in this estate.

searched: research\agents\campaign_r68_forward_activation\DATA_CERTIFICATION.json - read in full; contains NO per-year series and NO S&P 500 subset

repository-wide search for the literal values 0.7685, 0.7795, 0.8227, 15566, 309 and for coverage_by_year / declarationDate_nonnull_coverage_min_year - the ONLY hits are scripts\r61_settle_premeasurement_halts.py (the parent's own settlement metric name) and this ruling file itself
blocking_finding.timestamps: DATA_CERTIFICATION.json last written 2026-09-23 11:14:43, which PRECEDES this ruling file at 11:19:05. No append occurred after the original ruling. The campaign directory contains no other data-foundation output.
blocking_finding.conclusion: The figures were reported to me in a message but exist in no produced artifact. Under the no-hallucination rule I may not assert a data field that is not in an artifact I read, and I may not freeze a registration whose entire validity turns on one.

second_independent_defect_found_in_the_c.finding: DATA_CERTIFICATION.json certifies eodhd_dividend_declaration_v1 with prerequisite_verdict MET on the basis of declaration_date_coverage_pct 93.7 (58,884 of 62,855 records). That is a POOLED WHOLE-PANEL average. The frozen floor is defined against declarationDate_nonnull_coverage_min_year - a MINIMUM PER YEAR. A pooled 93.7% is arithmetically consistent with many individual years below 0.80, and on the very numbers now claimed it is: three years sit at 0.77-0.78 while the pooled figure is 93.7%.
second_independent_defect_found_in_the_c.consequence: The existing certification does not establish the reopen condition and should not be read as having done so. Its prerequisite_verdict MET is unsafe as written and needs restating against the floor's own statistic.
second_independent_defect_found_in_the_c.third_observation: The certified path is D:\Stock_Prediction_app_data\alpha_agent\r60_extension\us_equity_dividend_announcement_panel_v1.json, which is the PARENT row's own dataset_id. The change from the frozen extension panel to the S&P 500 is therefore a change of UNIVERSE over the same underlying file, and r68_sp500_event_universe is still unbuilt - universe-construction-agent has produced no artifact.

addendum_01.why_this_is_not_pedantry: This campaign exists because R67 proved a SUMMARY artifact misreported a family's state, and I was instructed to verify claims against primary evidence rather than summaries. Accepting an unrecorded series on report, in order to freeze a start date that only that series justifies, would reproduce exactly the failure mode the campaign was convened to repair. More concretely: the reopen condition requires the start be 'fixed FROM THE COVERAGE SERIES'. If the series is not an artifact, the start cannot be fixed from it in any AUDITABLE way - nobody can later check that 2012 was the mechanical answer rather than a preference. A frozen parameter whose provenance is a message is not frozen; it is unfalsifiable, and that is the hidden-tuning surface the no-hidden-tuning rule forbids.

conditional_ruling.status: PRE-COMMITTED. Recorded NOW, before any return is computed, so that it is mechanical rather than discretionary once the series is written to an artifact.
conditional_ruling.on_the_interpretive_question: TRIMMING IS AUTHORISED. The condition reads 'COVERAGE_CLEARS_THE_FROZEN_FLOOR: a NEW pre-registration whose sample start is fixed from the coverage series BEFORE any return is computed.' The clause 'whose sample start is fixed from the coverage series' is VACUOUS unless trimming is permitted - if the full recorded sample had to clear the floor, there would be no start to fix and the clause would do no work. The coherent reading is: set the start so that coverage OVER THE SAMPLE USED clears the frozen floor. So the full-sample-minimum reading is wrong and 2009-2011 need not be repaired first.

on_the_start_date.ruling: THERE IS NO CHOICE BETWEEN 2012 AND 2013, AND OFFERING ONE IS THE DISCRETION I MUST REFUSE.
on_the_start_date.frozen_rule: start = the EARLIEST year from which per-year non-null declarationDate coverage is continuously >= 0.80 through the end of sample.
on_the_start_date.why: The floor was frozen at 0.80 by the parent registration. Given a series, that rule returns exactly one answer and admits no discretion. On the numbers as claimed it returns 2012. Selecting 2013 instead would be applying an UNFROZEN, stricter floor after seeing the series - a free parameter introduced post hoc, and precisely the 'start date chosen after seeing a series' objection made real. The defence against that objection is not to pick the conservative option; it is to have no option.

on_the_shorter_sample_objection.partition_boundaries: The frozen partition boundaries 2018-01-01 (discovery/validation) and 2023-01-01 (validation/lockbox) DO NOT MOVE. Only the start moves.
on_the_shorter_sample_objection.consequence: The truncation falls ENTIRELY on discovery. Validation and lockbox sit wholly inside the 0.95+ coverage region and are untouched. That is the safest possible place for the loss and the lockbox is unaffected.
on_the_shorter_sample_objection.binding_disclosure: Effective observation count must be reported UP FRONT, before any test statistic, against the parent's frozen effective_observation_floor of 36. Below 36, the cell HALTS. The count is computed by alpha_agent.agents_v2.runner, not by me.

additional_blocking_gate_i_would_freeze.finding: A coverage floor tests the RATE of missingness, not its MECHANISM. At a 2012 coverage of 0.8227, roughly 18% of that year's records are dropped for want of a declaration date. If that missingness is correlated with the event class the signal selects on - initiations, cuts, material raises - the book is SELECTED and the estimate is biased no matter how cleanly the rate clears the floor. Nobody has measured this and it is not answered by the coverage series.
additional_blocking_gate_i_would_freeze.frozen_pre_measurement_check: Within the used sample, compare the distribution of the declared dividend change (computable from the dividend records alone, with NO returns) between rows WITH and WITHOUT declarationDate. Frozen before measurement; blocking; settles the cell DATA_HOLD if the missingness is concentrated in the event class the signal selects on.
additional_blocking_gate_i_would_freeze.why_this_adds_no_tuning_surface: It can only KILL, never rescue, and it touches no return series.

Estate burden would go 8,415 -> 8,416. Two attempts at one mechanism will have consumed search and that must remain visible; inheriting a denominator is not the same as being free.

exact_repair_needed_to_convert_this_into: 1. data-foundation-agent WRITES the per-year coverage series to DATA_CERTIFICATION.json as a recorded artifact: per-year non-null declarationDate coverage on the S&P 500 PIT universe, 2009-2026, with record and symbol counts, and the metric named declarationDate_nonnull_coverage_min_year so it is comparable to the parent's frozen floor.
2. The same agent RESTATES prerequisite_verdict against that statistic instead of the pooled 93.7%.
3. universe-construction-agent builds r68_sp500_event_universe; feature-library-agent publishes fs_r68_dividend_policy_change.
4. The parent's ledger state is reconciled to its memory outcome so there is only ever one live id.
5. The frozen start rule above is then applied MECHANICALLY - no further director discretion is required or permitted.
6. The missingness-mechanism check is executed pre-measurement and must pass.
addendum_01.what_the_release_should_record_if_step_1: A MEASURED DATA_HOLD is a real result and should be reported as one - but only once the measurement is IN AN ARTIFACT. As of this ruling the estate holds an UNRECORDED claim, which is a weaker thing than a measured DATA_HOLD and must not be written up as one.
